Subject: Your demo request — Redwood Inference

Thanks for signing up for a demo, Maya — we received your request and routed it to our Sales team.

Next steps: an AE will reach out to align stakeholders and lock a demo window. If you prefer to pick a time right away, use this link: https://cal.redwood.ai/lukas/30m?cid=asterhealth-demo

Subject: Re: Your demo request — aligning AE/SE/IT for the call

Hi Maya / Daniel — thanks for signing up, excited to connect. I'm Lukas (AE) and I'll run the demo. Marissa (sales manager) is looped in on scheduling.

Quick ask to make the session productive: could you confirm who from IT/security needs to attend (name + email)? For SE-level questions I'd like Soojin (our SE) to join the demo and, if possible, do a short 15-min technical pre-call with your IT contact to validate networking/SSO needs.

I've proposed a few 30-min demo windows that try to respect cross-timezone overlap:
- Mon May 3, 08:00–08:30 PT (16:30–17:00 BST; 21:00–21:30 IST)
- Mon May 3, 11:00–11:30 PT (19:00–19:30 BST; 00:30–01:00 IST next day) — less ideal for IST
- Tue May 4, 09:00–09:30 PT (17:00–17:30 BST; 22:30–23:00 IST)

If none of those work, tell us a preferred 60-min block and we can expand. I've attached a short demo brief so you can circulate it to your team.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: redwood-demo-brief.pdf

Thanks Lukas — copying our security and ops folks.

Maya and I looked at the windows. Our IT/security (Sanjay Rao, security@asterhealth.com) can do a 15-min pre-check on Mon May 3 at 20:50 IST (08:20 PT) — that maps to your first proposed window (08:00 PT) if we nudge a bit. For the live demo we prefer Tue May 4, 09:00 PT (your Tue slot) so our product team (Maya) can stay late for the walkthrough.

Two notes:
- We have an internal attestation PDF describing our baseline SSO/OAuth config; attaching for your SE to scan through (aster_it_attestation.pdf).
- We will need a brief on expected network egress and any IP allowlists since we run behind a strict VPC egress filter.

Can Soojin confirm availability for the 15-min pre-check Mon 20:50 IST and the Tue demo 09:00 PT?

On Mon 20:50 IST Sanjay will join from Bangalore; on Tue we'll have Maya (product), Daniel (platform), and a couple of engineers.

Thanks,
Daniel Park

+91 98 7654 3210

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-03T07:02:00-07:00

Hi Daniel — thanks for the details and for sending the attestation. I'm available for the 15-min pre-check on Mon May 3 at 20:50 IST (08:20 PT) and for the Tue May 4 demo at 09:00 PT. I'll review the attestation before the pre-check and have a short checklist ready so we can validate allowlists, SSO redirect URIs, and any cert pinning requirements.

I've attached a lightweight pre-call checklist and added the key questions below so your security team can prepare: 
- Are outbound IP ranges controllable or do we need to support static egress IPs?
- Which IdP are you on (Okta, Azure AD, custom SAML)? Any SAML metadata?
- Do you require an on-prem connector or can we run through SAML/OIDC direct?

If you want, I can hop on a quick test call 10 minutes before the scheduled pre-check to confirm audio + network.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: precall-checklist.txt
